question: Should Neuralwatt expose both prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh capacity, or intentionally ship a balance-only provider that can appear exhausted while subscription capacity remains?
rationale: The API returns two independently usable quota pools with different units, and automated review cannot choose the permanent user-facing contract.

options.title: Show both quota pools
options.body: Render prepaid credits and subscription kWh as separate metrics so the menu reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt capacity.

options.title: Approve balance-only semantics
options.body: Keep the smaller UI surface and explicitly accept and document that active subscription capacity is omitted.

recommendation.title: Show both quota pools
recommendation.body: Render prepaid credits and subscription kWh as separate metrics so the menu reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt capacity.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the quota-limit and presentation hardening and is the clearest available owner for this product contract.
